description: Excalidraw is a collaborative whiteboarding and diagramming service. Its Excalidraw Plus offering adds workspace management, scenes, collections, and programmable access for integrations and AI clients.
summary: Excalidraw exposes a beta REST API at `https://api.excalidraw.com/api/v1` and a streamable-HTTP MCP server cataloged at `https://mcp.excalidraw.com/mcp`; both use Excalidraw Plus API keys via `Authorization: Bearer`.
